name: Yofune Hatsuho
source:
Her family is an old shrine family that has been enshrining a local deity for generations.
Usually, she runs a mysterious grocery store that her father had purchased on the grounds of the shrine, and when she's not at the store, she can be found in front of the station with a musical instrument in her hand, performing live on the streets.

She is often called "Onee-sama" at her girls' school and often receives chocolates on Valentine's Day, but she feels that the girls who have feelings for her are only in love with romance and do not see the real her. While having the doubt of "what is the real me?", she is always seeking something to be the focal point of her life.
